note: Real, dated, named-buyer export shipments are confirmed: Indian black tea (Assam/orthodox/CTC) in bulk, HS 09024020 / 09024040 / 09024090 / 09024010, ex Kolkata Sea (INCCU1), Nhava Sheva (INNSA1) and Cochin (INCOK1) to St Petersburg (Russia), Jebel Ali (UAE) and, per the mirror source, OOO 'PATRON' (Russia). Declared HS in the batch was 090230;090240 — the observed records are all 090240xx (bulk black tea >3 kg), so the 090240 part matches and 090230 (packaged retail tea) is not evidenced in the rows seen; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, code should be recorded as the factual 09024020/09024040/09024090/09024010. Domestic (India) supply side is unverified — not 'none found', simply not public in the sources I could reach; GST turnover and GeM/CPPP participation remain null. Revenue/export value figures are not published on the free views, so left null rather than estimated. Note the two ImportKey slugs appear to be the same Kolkata Ezra Street entity (54 Ezra Street, Kolkata-700001) — one page is the India-customs view, the other the mirror/US view; I did not treat them as two separate companies.
